# tinystruct

> tinystruct is a lightweight Java 17+ framework in which CLI and HTTP are equal citizens: a public method annotated with `@Action` runs both from the terminal (`bin/dispatcher <action>`) and over HTTP, with no `main()` method and minimal configuration. It ships its own HTTP server, JSON (`Builder`/`Builders`), database persistence (`AbstractData`), SSE, events and MCP server support. Maven coordinates: `org.tinystruct:tinystruct`, latest documented release 1.7.39.

Rules for generating tinystruct code:

- Applications extend `org.tinystruct.AbstractApplication`; set up in `init()`, not the constructor. API-only apps call `setTemplateRequired(false)`.
- Routes are `public` methods with `@Action("path")`. Without a `mode` an action works from CLI and HTTP; `mode = Mode.HTTP_POST`, `Mode.CLI`, etc. restrict it.
- Never write `main(String[] args)`. Run and test through `bin/dispatcher` (Windows: `bin\dispatcher.cmd`), which the framework generates.
- Use `org.tinystruct.data.component.Builder`/`Builders` for JSON, not Jackson or Gson.
- Configuration is `src/main/resources/application.properties`, read with `getConfiguration("key")`.

- [tinystruct-patterns SKILL.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tinystruct/tinystruct/master/.agents/skills/tinystruct-patterns/SKILL.md): Condensed patterns, examples and anti-patterns for coding agents; start here
- [Architecture & configuration](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tinystruct/tinystruct/master/.agents/skills/tinystruct-patterns/references/architecture.md): Core abstractions, package map, properties
- [Routing & @Action](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tinystruct/tinystruct/master/.agents/skills/tinystruct-patterns/references/routing.md): Annotation details, modes, parameter binding
- [Data handling](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tinystruct/tinystruct/master/.agents/skills/tinystruct-patterns/references/data-handling.md): Builder, Builders, JSON serialization and parsing
- [Database persistence](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tinystruct/tinystruct/master/.agents/skills/tinystruct-patterns/references/database.md): AbstractData POJOs, CRUD, mapping, POJO generation
- [System & usage](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tinystruct/tinystruct/master/.agents/skills/tinystruct-patterns/references/system-usage.md): Context, sessions, SSE, file uploads, events, networking
- [Testing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tinystruct/tinystruct/master/.agents/skills/tinystruct-patterns/references/testing.md): JUnit 5 unit and HTTP integration tests
